acceptance_criteria.criterion: All 7 ledger persona YAML files contain an id key with the correct ledger-{stem} value
All 10 standalone persona YAML files contain an id key with the correct standalone-{stem} value
YAML files remain valid and parseable after the change

summary: Added id field to all 7 ledger persona YAML files (ledger-1-planner through ledger-7-synthesis) and all 10 standalone persona YAML files (standalone-agents-md-curator through standalone-whatsnew-curator). The id field was inserted after vs_file_name in each file. All 17 files validated successfully with js-yaml.

comments.note: The ledger YAML files (personas/ledger/src/meta/) use a number+role schema while standalone files use slug+name. These parallel schemas serve the same purpose but are structurally inconsistent — a shared identity section could unify them if the build script is ever refactored.

summary: All 4 acceptance criteria verified. All 17 persona YAML files (7 ledger + 10 standalone) have correct id fields following the ledger-{stem}/standalone-{stem} pattern, derived exactly from vs_file_name.

All YAMLs parse cleanly via js-yaml. No other fields were modified. Build pipeline (build-personas.js) remains fully functional — 14 personas built cleanly and --check mode confirms all are up-to-date.

Role parity check passes (check-known-roles.js). Edge-case: shared _shared.yaml files correctly have no id field. The 2 failing MCP server tests are pre-existing and unrelated to this WP — they involve WP-002 through WP-004 scope (MCP server source) which was not touched by WP-001.

metrics.notes: 2 failing tests are pre-existing and out of WP-001 scope (MCP server logic in other WPs). All 17 persona YAML id assertions pass programmatic validation.

comments.note: The 2 pre-existing test failures are in workflow-next-action.test.ts (PM WAIT handoff_status embedding) and ledger-store.test.ts (EPERM vs EISDIR on Windows). Neither touches YAML files. They belong to other in-progress WPs.
Edge-case verified: _shared.yaml files in both ledger and standalone suites correctly have no id field — they are shared config, not persona definitions.

summary: All 17 persona YAML files verified in source. `personas/ledger/src/meta/1-planner.yaml` confirms `id: ledger-1-planner` at line 4 (after `vs_file_name`). `personas/standalone/src/meta/researcher.yaml` confirms `id: standalone-researcher` at line 5. Pattern follows `ledger-{stem}` / `standalone-{stem}` as required. All 4 ACs confirmed met. No extraneous changes introduced. The improvement observation about YAML schema inconsistency between ledger and standalone is noted but out of scope.

comments.note: id field is inserted after vs_file_name in ledger YAMLs and standalone YAMLs consistently. _shared.yaml files in both suites correctly have no id field. No actionable rework required.
